# Odyz

> Odyz is a privacy-first travel tracker for iPhone and iPad, made by wOzy. It turns the photos already on your phone into trips, a 3D map and a digital passport of every country and city you've been to, and collects a landmark stamp for every place you visit. No account is needed, and your travel history is processed on your device. Free to download.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/odyz/id6736624376
- X: https://x.com/odyzapp
- Made by [wOzy](https://www.wozy.co/), a small independent studio making iPhone and iPad apps since 2010

## Features

- Trips, maps and stats built automatically from the location and date in your photos; no check-ins
- Digital passport: continents, countries and cities visited, share of the world explored, trips, days traveling, photos and distance traveled, in light and dark modes
- Compare passports with friends
- 3D map with your photos pinned where they were taken, inside landmarks or out on the street
- Travel timeline organized by year, and a world map with a pin for every place you've been
- All 193 UN countries plus many more territories
- Collectible landmark stamps for the places you visit

## Pricing

- Free, with no ads and no account required. Core travel tracking stays free: unlimited countries, regions and cities, with no limits on years or historical data
- Optional Odyz Pro subscription for custom themes, home screen widgets and exclusive travel icons

## Help

- [Odyz help center](https://www.odyz.app/help/): Answers to common questions, step by step with screenshots
- [How do I track my trips?](https://www.odyz.app/help/track-trips/): Odyz builds trips automatically from the location and date in your photos, including trips from years ago
- [How do I see my travel stats?](https://www.odyz.app/help/travel-stats/): The digital passport: continents, countries, cities, share of the world explored, trips, days traveling, photos and distance, for all time or any year
- [How do I know how many countries I've visited?](https://www.odyz.app/help/how-many-countries/): Odyz counts every country in your photos; covers all 193 UN countries plus territories
- [How do I see which countries I've visited?](https://www.odyz.app/help/which-countries/): The World Trips map and a list of visited countries by continent
- [How do I see which cities I've visited?](https://www.odyz.app/help/which-cities/): The timeline, the pin map, the 3D city tour and the passport's city count
